sentences.en: Hey, everyone, I'm Josh Radner, and I am so excited to tell you about How We Made Your Mother,
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是乔什·拉德纳，我非常高兴向大家介绍《我们是如何制作你母亲的》，

sentences.en: a rewatch podcast looking back episode by episode at the hit TV show, How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重温播客，将逐集回顾热门电视剧《老爸老妈的浪漫史》。

sentences.en: I played Ted Mosby, The Eye, in How I Met Your Mother for all nine seasons.
sentences.zh: 我在《老爸老妈的浪漫史》中饰演了整整九季的泰德·莫斯里，也就是“眼睛”。

sentences.en: And I'm here with Craig Thomas, who co-created the show along with Carter Bayes.
sentences.zh: 我身旁是克雷格·托马斯，他与卡特·贝斯共同创作了这部剧。

sentences.en: Hi, Craig.
sentences.zh: 嗨，克雷格。

sentences.en: Hey, Josh.
sentences.zh: 嗨，乔什。

sentences.en: Somehow it has been 20 years since the show premiered.
sentences.zh: 不知不觉，这部剧首播已经20年了。

sentences.en: I'm going to check the math on that.
sentences.zh: 我要核对一下这个数学计算。

sentences.en: That seems wrong.
sentences.zh: 这听起来好像不对。

sentences.en: 10 years since it went off the air, and we thought that made this a perfect time to look back,
sentences.zh: 距离它停播已经10年了，我们觉得这是回顾的绝佳时机，

sentences.en: see what the hell we did, and why the show still seems to resonate with fans around the world today.
sentences.zh: 看看我们到底干了些什么，为什么这部剧至今仍能引起世界各地粉丝的共鸣。

sentences.en: And we are thrilled to announce that we have now joined the Office Ladies Network
sentences.zh: 我们非常激动地宣布，我们现在已经加入了“办公室女士”网络，

sentences.en: and are just beyond excited to be working with Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 并且对于能与珍娜·费舍和安吉拉·金西合作感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Josh.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，乔什。

sentences.en: We are thrilled to have you and Craig be part of the Office Ladies family.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴你和克雷格能成为“办公室女士”大家庭的一员。

sentences.en: And something we love about How We Made Your Mother is the amazing community of this show.
sentences.zh: 我们对《我们是如何制作你母亲的》最喜爱的一点，就是这部剧拥有令人惊叹的粉丝群体。

sentences.en: The fans and people that write in, we think you guys are awesome.
sentences.zh: 那些粉丝和写信来的人，我们觉得你们太棒了。

sentences.en: And I love when Josh and Craig get philosophical.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢乔什和克雷格变得富有哲理的时候。

sentences.en: I mean, I love all the behind-the-scenes stories,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我喜欢所有的幕后故事，

sentences.en: but my favorite is when Josh suddenly starts quoting Einstein or some ancient philosopher,
sentences.zh: 但我最喜欢的是乔什突然开始引用爱因斯坦或某个古代哲学家的话，

sentences.en: and then he and Craig basically break down the meaning of love
sentences.zh: 然后他和克雷格基本上开始剖析爱的含义，

sentences.en: or the power of friendship or forgiveness or you name it.
sentences.zh: 或是友谊、宽恕的力量，或是随便你说的什么。

sentences.en: In season one of our podcast, we had a great time looking back at the 22 episodes of Him-Yim season one.
sentences.zh: 在我们播客的第一季中，我们回顾了《老爸老妈》第一季的22集，度过了一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: I was so into him being with Robin when he goes up in the suit.
sentences.zh: 当他穿着西装出场时，我太喜欢他和罗宾在一起了。

sentences.en: And it's really quite sexy for prime time, just in terms of like the way they're looking at each other.
sentences.zh: 而且从他们彼此注视的方式来看，这在黄金时段节目中确实相当性感。

sentences.en: But the moment he says, I think I'm in love with you, I almost was like, what?
sentences.zh: 但当他说出“我想我爱上你了”那一刻，我几乎心想：什么？

sentences.en: Ashley Williams?
sentences.zh: 阿什莉·威廉姆斯？

sentences.en: One time Josh was like, you kind of like are like pushing me away with your mouth every time we can.
sentences.zh: 有一次乔什说：“每次我们亲吻时，你都有点像是在用嘴把我要推开。”

sentences.en: But I think what I was saying was, and it was very delicate what I was trying to do, which was to say.
sentences.zh: 但我想我当时的意思是——我当时试图做得很微妙——也就是想说。

sentences.en: Yeah, how did you say this?
sentences.zh: 对，你是怎么说的？

sentences.en: I think what I was saying was like, you're kissing me weird, right?
sentences.zh: 我想我当时的意思是：你吻我的方式真奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: I think that's all I was saying.

sentences.en: It was like, you're kissing me weird.

sentences.en: And our very own Kobe Smulders.
sentences.zh: 还有我们自己的科比·史加德斯。

sentences.en: There are people who are our age who are like, I remember being in my 20s watching this show.
sentences.zh: 有些和我们同龄的人会说：“我记得我20多岁的时候看过这部剧。”

sentences.en: And you're like, yeah, same, same.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会说：“对啊，同感，同感。”

sentences.en: Like, and it feels very like relatable.

sentences.en: And now we are launching season two.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要推出第二季了。

sentences.en: And while it wouldn't be him if we didn't keep a few secrets, we can tell you that we'll be talking with Joe Manganiello.
sentences.zh: 虽然如果不保留几个秘密就不叫《老爸老妈》了，但我们可以告诉大家，我们将与乔·曼根尼罗进行交谈。

sentences.en: People make me do that line to them a lot.
sentences.zh: 大家经常让我对他们说那句台词。

sentences.en: B2W, which is also another a breathe.
sentences.zh: B2W，这也是另一种呼吸。

sentences.en: And the amazing Bryan Cranston.
sentences.zh: 还有了不起的布莱恩·克兰斯顿。

sentences.en: Whether it's How I Met Your Mother, whether it's Breaking Bad, the thing, the question we always get asked is, did you know it was going to be a hit?
sentences.zh: 无论是《老爸老妈的浪漫史》，还是《绝命毒师》，我们经常被问到的一个问题是：你们当时知道它会火吗？

sentences.en: And I go, no one ever knows.
sentences.zh: 而我的回答是，没有人会提前知道。

sentences.en: But what you do know and what I knew about How I Met Your Mother is that it was good.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的以及我所知道的关于《老爸老妈浪漫史》的一点是，它确实很棒。

sentences.en: So check out our website, HowWeMadeYourMother.com, where you can send in voice messages and emails.
